Eight people were injured after a portion of a building collapsed while the roof slab of its second floor was being laid in central Delhi’s Paharganj on Sunday (November 15, 2026).
The incident took place at property numbers 3992–3993 in Kasheruwalan, Sangatrashan, opposite Government Girls Senior Secondary School. The injured were taken to Lady Hardinge Medical College and Hospital. Some have suffered fractures, while others sustained minor injuries.
Preliminary inspection found that the supporting columns were wet and the building appeared to have tilted. Police are examining the circumstances leading to the collapse.
